verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the official Statsig MCP server, which lets users ask questions about their experiments and Statsig data through external AI clients like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. That delivers AI-driven exploration of the data, but outside the Statsig product rather than inside it. Missing for 10: any evidence of an in-console AI assistant, AI-generated insight summaries or recommendations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI insight quality.
